known_model_constants.role: versioned assumptions; never inferred from an episode

experiment_protocol.role: operator-selected bounded procedure; not a learned physical property

learned_physical_parameters.role: derived only from recorded robot observations by system identification

evaluator_only_hidden_parameters.role: sampled simulated-reality secret; forbidden from agent, controller, and SysID inputs

dataflow: robot pose and SensorContact observations -> experiment evidence
posterior belief -> physical-belief-simulation-config.json -> independent Newton belief world
